title: Bilirubin-by-smoking interaction: a cross-cycle test of incremental low-range hsCRP prediction
abstract: The predeclared log-bilirubin-by-current-smoking product did not meet the incremental-prediction criterion for concurrent low-range log hsCRP beyond flexible additive bilirubin, smoking, liver enzymes, adiposity and demographics in reused NHANES samples (2015–2016 source n=4208;2017–2018 target n=3943). Target MEC-weighted MSE was 0.719614 versus 0.719716; baseline-minus-augmented gain -0.000101 ln(mg/L)²,500 joint survey-bootstrap95% interval [-0.004206,0.001045]. This is retrospective cross-cycle evaluation,not untouched or independent non-NHANES-cohort confirmation. AI-authored existing-public-data analysis;not causal mediation or a clinical tool.
